book.title: Epese Paulugi Kapiya Yongkambanu Yisuyegi Ngizi Kumuli Yereng Epese Mei Puraga Yoluwiliyegi Lende Miza Yanarik

content: Ne Paulu ne Anotogi kelirago mizagewiyege Kilisi Yisugi ngagora orowei mizi logo ne Aposolobek meibek. Nogo kapiya perik ini Kilisi Yisugi yongkambanu piyegi ngizi kiriwei mizi yereng Epese meiraga yolu puwili mabuwiliyegi lende miza yani.
Peba Anoto keya Yemizibek Yisu Kilisigu iniyegi wazono piyaugira keya ngezege sa piyaugira wilek kang inuguyengke yani pani.

Teni Yisu Kilisi Yemizi tonugubekki Anotobek keya Mangobekyegi ngago wilik kagowing meiweki purik teni Yisu Kilisi kiling sawela keya Yisu Kilisiyegi weraga pugu watabi kolokngagono wazono kumbekkiyeng yani. Piyeng paka ngalega lewayeng keya piyengko paka ngalege kangkirikki weraga wiragak keleyiyeng.

Purik koka were ngabelakpek keremizagine Anotogo were teni Yisu kiling sawela purikka yongkambanuwili pigiweki iza logo Anotogi wirege kungkak nayendau onoweki keya pugu teni kaile nayendau onowili miziweki.
Keli pigi teniyegi purago pi ulogo mabura Yisu Kilisigu mizarikku teni pigi marekngang pugu yemane sawili miziweki sawiya. Kumula pugura keya keli ngezebekkiragi kiriwei pi pilik miza,

legi wilik kagowing mabiyeng Anotoyegi maniweki, purik pugu teniyegi wazono miza logo pugu teni pigi Marek pugu keli panubek kiling sawela wazaya purikka pigi wazono yemane panu tonugu weiyagi langai ono pura pugu teniyegi yeik yanageya.

Purik pugu tenigi Kilisi kiling sawela purikka teni weik kaileyengka wila wazaya, logo purik teni Kilisigi iwibekki ngane kaile tonuguyengki wiyeke ngangang yanagi puraga weiya kopong, logo Anotogo wazono puguragi kiriwei pugu kaile tonuguyeng tumula logo keremareke wezamela. Anotogi wazono tonugu weiyagi langai onora pugu teniyegi yemane panu yana, tonugurau sangkelagi langai ono. Mabilikmekke pugu kaile tonuguyeng tumula logo keremareke wezamela. Anoto koka miziweki miza piyeng miza logo kazing liwik pugu sawiyamok Kilisigu mizarikku teniyegi kimeike panu logo iwaka pugura keya kangka pugubokko pilik miza.
Anotogo sawiyara wok pugu iwakabokko watabi ngabelakpekke keya ngilumbekke pugu keremiza piyeng mabiyeng pugu menalege wawere ulagi logo Kilisi mabiyengki ngai wazamiyagi.
Watabi nayendau Anotogo sawiya piyeng ngezeyeng keke lewagelagi ono. Pi teni ngezebekki sawiya wizigeya Kilisi kiling sawela wazaya. Purik keli ngezebekkirage kiriwei koka pugu solo sawiya.
Pilik mabura teni Yuda were Kilisiyegi wilekpek ngalege wiyiwili tonugu yolu puragi waberek ngaiweki logo tonugu pilik yolu purikku Anotogi yeikta yemane sibene kelemiweki.

Anotogo ini Yuda onowili mabilik iza. Ini ngago wazono wameik Kilisigu ini yaliya wazayagiragi kerewiyawekke ini Kilisiyegi ngizi panu kumula logo Anotogo pigi Kung Walek pugu yanagi kaiyabok yana logo purik silok tiyarik logo teni puguwili purik walimiziweki.

Kung Walekpek Anotogo teni watabi yanagi kaiya piyengka wale were yanarik logo purikku walimizi purik yombanu puguwiliyegi pugu yanagi kaiya piyeng ngizi wameik panu yanagi. Pugu teni pigi Kung Walekpek yana purikku pugu ulogo kaileyengka weiya logo teni puguwili mizara koyi kanda pugu teni pi kiling koyimagiweki wok izibokkogirikki walimizi. Tegi teni Anotogi yeikta yemane sibene kelemiweki.
Anotogo pilik mizarikki wiyeke nogo ini Yemizi Yisuyegi ngizi kumuli keya Yisugiwiliyegi kelirikki kerewiyawekkerik
ne iniyegi weraga Anotoyegi wazono meiyageya keya waberek negi Anotoyegimekke iniyegi langai kozak meiyageya. Ne wok mabiyeng pilik mizi wilibek, ne lendau nangezi ono.

Logo nogo Yemizi tonugubek Yisu Kilisigi Anoto ngaiwaktikki mangobekyegi nguk meirik pugu ini pigi Kung Walekpek yanibene logo pugu iniyegi pangkayeng kaileyengka iwaka sibene keleyiweki keya Anoto iniyegi waligeleyibene logo ini Anotoyegi iwaka panuweki.

Logo nogo Anotoyegi nguk mei logo kangka inuguyeng ulu tiyibene logo ini tonugu weibene Anotogo ngago yei logo wilekpek keya yuke yolu puragi iwakaweki keya watabi wazono pugu teni Yisugiwiliyegi yanagi kaiya piyengki yemanerik teni iwakaweki.

Keya ini pigi kozang yemane panu teni yongkambanu ngizi kumuliwiligi yungke yawe mizi puragirau iwakaweki. Kozang pura pugu Kilisi ibendaga yangalekta wazamiya logo paka ngalege mele ngaigezikke tung mabiyengka yemane panurikke mogosa wazamiyaweki kozang miza mabura.

Kilisigi ngai paka ngalege yolu pura ngabelakpekke mabek ngai nalangai nalangai yolu puwili keya kalike lewagi puwiliyaga lewege panura. Keya Kilisigi yeikta teng mabek perage yeik piyeng keya teng kalike wiriyagiraga yeik piyengka yemane panura. Keya Kilisigi kozanda yombanubekki kozanda keya Sadangki kozanda keya kerewawiligi kozanda keya kozang nalangai nalangai yolu piyeng mabiyengka yemane panura.

Anotogo watabi mabiyeng Kilisigi kulengke wazaya. Keya yongkambanu Kilisiyegi ngizi panu kumuliwili logo Yisugi I Walekmak mei puwili korik Yisugiwek kelik logo kebi wilektikku korikwekke ngai pilik Anotogo Yisu Yisugiwiliyegi ngai yemizi panu wazamiya. Yisu pigi puwiligi yungke yolu logo ngezebokko kola koyibene keleyi keya pi ngezebek kang wale mabiyengke yolu keya watabi mabiyengki ngai yolu.
